reason: An r02 Pocket2Mol job exceeded 24 GiB even after its co-located TargetDiff job had finished, showing that the retry-r01 batch size of 32 was not executable on a 24 GiB RTX 4090 for every sampled trajectory.
prelaunch_disposition: Retry-r01 was stopped before any retry job state or model inference. Recovery-r03 was stopped before merged state or phase-2 inference.
failed_job_freeze_rule: After both original Pocket2Mol workers are terminal, include every r02 Pocket2Mol job with a nonzero exit code and no r02 success; freeze the exact list before retry inference.

invariants.gpu_policy: physical GPU 6 must be free of compute processes before sequential retries start

scientific_effect: Batch size is an execution-memory amendment. Pocket, seed, total attempt budget, generator, evaluator and analysis remain unchanged.
